name: MLV-Bench
description: MLV-Bench is a Hugging Face-hosted multimodal benchmark that evaluates models on a mix of vision+language tasks (e.g., VQA, captioning, multiple-choice visual reasoning). It measures a model's ability to align visual content with natural language across several task formats and reports per-task metrics and an overall composite score. The suite is intended for comparative evaluation of multimodal models rather than as a single-task leaderboard.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for multimodal model evaluation.
